items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: Jerry had set up the thing with Label X with a guy named Jimmy Hilliard... I was to contribute some of the charts and he was going to do the other charts.

ctx.x: We were talking about? The second album.

The album. Well, we had--Jerry had set up the thing with Label X with a guy named Jimmy Hilliard that represented the company. They were a subsidiary of RCA Victor, and Jimmy Hilliard had originally booked an all star jazz date under the director--I can't think of the other musician--it was supposed to be the front, under his leadership, and I was to contribute some of the charts and he was going to do the other charts.
